program.name: ndm_refeaturize
program.help:
Re-project spike waveforms onto the saved PCA basis and rewrite .fet (without refitting PCA).
ndm_refeaturize reads .spk.<method>.N and the eigenvectors in .pca.<method>.N (written by ndm_pca) and recomputes .fet.<method>.N by projection only. Use it as a fast alternative to a full ndm_pca re-run when the spikes have shifted but the basis is still valid — e.g. after ndm_alignspikes_pca — so the features stay consistent with the updated waveforms.
The engine (method: standard, sdiff, or stderiv) and, for sdiff/stderiv, the spatial-derivative order (methodOrder) are set in the session's ndm_refeaturize program node; they are not declared here. For stderiv the linearly-dependent channel (orders 1 and 3) is dropped before projection, matching the input ndm_pca fit the basis on. The .fet.<method>.N is overwritten.
PARAMETERS
# extra
Append per-channel peak values as extra features. Must match the `extra` setting ndm_pca used when the basis was fit, or the feature column count will disagree.
